Lines: uncollided (analytic half-space kernel, MC-validated) plus the uncollided 511-keV annihilation line (MC); continuum: scattered photons (MC), uniform within each bin. EnergyZenith: zenith cosine = propagation direction . world +y (up), ground below, azimuth uniform; uncollided ground photons have mu>0. Lines and scattered photons below 10 keV are not in the file.
